package.description: Your manga reading list, on autopilot - built from your browser history.

en-US.description: Your manga reading list, on autopilot - built from your browser history.
en-US.longDescription: SyncManga reads your browser history (read-only), detects which manga series you read and which chapter you are on, and builds an interactive reading list with verified continue-reading links, ratings, filters, favorites, day/night mode, import/export (MyAnimeList/AniList) and recommendations. Everything runs locally; your history never leaves your PC.
en-US.name: SyncManga
